g.text: One line per tested transcript; length = log2FC H1975 / HCC827 (outward = higher in H1975, capped at ±8).
Inner circle: pair = DE novel transcript + its most correlated DE neighbour ≤ 1 Mb (|ρ| > 0.5), zoomed; outer lane = novel, inner lane = neighbour.
Bar = transcript, +/− = its strand; link = cis pair (solid: ρ > 0, dashed: ρ < 0); pair numbers as in the heatmap.
z-score of log2 normalised count | ρ = Spearman, n = 6 samples
